## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The release gate fails open and must be fixed before merge: when the results file is missing, `load_results` returns `[]`, so `release_allowed` returns `True`.

## Changes
This pull request makes `load_results` return an empty list when the results file is missing. It adds `display_preferences`, which falls back to a light theme when the preferences file is absent, and adds tests for both functions.

## Critical
- app/results.py:7 — correctness — Don't allow release when the results file is missing — When `results.json` does not exist, `load_results` returns `[]`, and `release_allowed` evaluates `all([])`, which is `True`. Unlike the preferences fallback, this fallback has no log, comment or caller signal, and no test covers the missing-file branch. — A deleted, misnamed or never-written results file lets a release through without running any checks. — Fix: Let `FileNotFoundError` propagate from `load_results`, or make `release_allowed` return `False` when no results exist, and extend `test_saved_checks_control_release` with a missing-file case.
